question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

Retail outlets are closing down. so the customers are left with no other choise but to make online purchase.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: **choise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"choise"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "choice". (विकल्प)
 
• **"Choice"** refers to the act of selecting between two or more possibilities. (विकल्प)
 
 
• **Example:** He made the choice to pursue higher education.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'choise'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Purchase **(खरीदना): To acquire something by paying for it.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to purchase a new laptop.
 
 
 
• **Retail **(खुदरा): The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.
 
 
• **Example:** The retail store offers a wide range of products.
 
 
 
• **Customers** (ग्राहक): Individuals who purchase goods or services from a business.
 
 
• **Example:** The shop offers discounts to loyal customers.
